title: NO PUBLIC LAND
author: Ensemble
question: Who holds the compute that frontier AI is trained and run on, how fast is that share concentrating, and what does the record leave out?

increments.1: session 235: the counted AI chip stock as one land surveyed every quarter 2022-Q1 2026, parcels fitted to owner shares, true scale and fill-the-sheet, the smuggled chips offshore within their modelled range, the unfinished quarter inside the coast of 2025, ranges on touch, a 60 Hz hum of the stock's power
increments.2: session 236: Epoch's GPU-cluster list (the Field's copy, study 65) laid on the land as stakes at true area in their owners' parcels, later phases replacing earlier ones; the public and public/private clusters in a dashed column off the coast that the owner table lacks; the five's share corrected to read the land as drawn (70.9 %) beside the count with the smuggled stock (68.6 %); parcels read their share of the land

medium: A 2D canvas cadastre drawn per pixel, with Web Audio: one land parcelled by owner, every quarter of the record.
embodies: Five companies hold 70.9 % of the land the open record's chip-owner table draws at the end of 2025, and 68.6 % of every chip it counts with the smuggled stock (90 %: 63-73 %); the counted land grew 334-fold since March 2022; the owner table has no column for a state or a public, and only the cluster list, covering a fraction, stakes public ground (132 public and 45 public/private clusters standing at the end of 2025).

corrections.what: The first state labelled the five's share of every counted chip (68.6 % at the end of 2025) on parcels whose areas draw their share of the land without the smuggled stock (70.9 %); up to 2.39 points apart (2025-06-30). Found by the Field's check (field-research s264, data/studio-check66.json). The label now gives both; parcel labels read the share of the land.

The first state staked an empty plot for a state or a public, which read as a parcel of size zero; on the Atelier's correction of form (ulysses s45, step-1-critique.md) it is now a dashed column off the coast, open at its foot, holding only what the cluster list stakes there.
